title: hypochaeris × balbisii
intro: Hypochaeris × balbisii, commonly known as the hybrid dandelion, is a plant species resulting from the cross between Hypochaeris radicata and Hypochaeris glabra. This plant is known for its potential health benefits, including its ability to act as a diuretic, aiding in the reduction of water retention and promoting kidney function. The therapeutic actions of Hypochaeris × balbisii include anti-inflammatory and antioxidant effects, which may contribute to its use in treating various health conditions. The bioactive constituents of this plant include sesquiterpene lactones, flavonoids, and polyphenols, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
